updatePolicy: Change the pinned commit only after reviewing upstream compatibility, license notices, manifests, and source diffs.
executionPolicy: Robinhood's route UI remains locked until payload provenance and hardware verification are independently recorded.
notes: The upstream source contains the WebKit userland adapters, kernel chain dispatch, firmware tables, and per-firmware AppCache manifests.
GoldHEN is not bundled by this integration; its binary is closed-source and must be supplied from a trusted release with an independently recorded SHA-256.
A source-listed route is not a guarantee of success on every console revision. Test each target firmware on physical hardware.
